name: Delves into Forbidden Knowledge
description: You've studied ancient and terrible secrets that man was not meant to know, gaining both power and peril from your eldritch understanding.
connectionOptions: One PC helped you acquire a dangerous tome you've been seeking.
You're investigating an ancestral curse that affects one PC's family.
One PC witnessed you performing a ritual and is both fascinated and terrified.
You sense that one PC has been touched by forces beyond mortal comprehension.
additionalEquipment: Eldritch tome (possibly bound in human skin)
Journal filled with cryptic notes and diagrams

abilities.name: Eldritch Insight
abilities.description: You're trained in tasks related to occult knowledge, ancient languages, and recognizing otherworldly phenomena.

abilities.name: Mind Shield
abilities.description: Your exposure to cosmic horrors has hardened your mind. You have +2 Armor against mental attacks and Intellect damage.

abilities.name: Ritual Casting
abilities.description: You can perform minor eldritch rituals. The effects are usually subtle but can provide valuable information or temporary protection from supernatural forces.

abilities.name: Glimpse Beyond
abilities.description: Once per day, you can attempt to perceive hidden truths or unseen entities. This is an Intellect task that risks temporary Intellect damage on failure.

abilities.name: Whispers from Beyond
abilities.description: You can attempt to communicate with extradimensional entities for information. This is extremely dangerous and may attract unwanted attention.

abilities.name: Reality Distortion
abilities.description: You can warp local reality in minor ways, such as causing unsettling visual or auditory phenomena. This can provide an asset to intimidation or deception tasks.

abilities.name: Gate of Yog-Sothoth
abilities.description: Once per session, you can attempt to open a temporary portal to another dimension or summon an otherworldly entity. This is incredibly risky and may have severe consequences.
